alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right. The amber one starts a story with a speech bubble that says so anyway, and the blue one answers mhm. The amber one continues with and then, stops with wide eyes, looks up and says wait. It looks away and trembles, and asks what was I saying? The blue one answers the dog, and the amber one's eyes turn happy with a big pulse. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me losing the point of my own story.
